**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause: `dep-4471` set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true` while pool size stayed 20. Each request now pins a connection, so past 20 concurrent, the rest fail.

Window: `02:14:18.972Z` to log end `03:59:27.974Z`, still failing. 530 of 636 requests got a 503, 83%. The only 200s were `/health`.

One number I gave earlier was the last line, not the peak. The wait queue topped out at 271.

Next: roll back `dep-4471`.
